## Symbolic share and the Amdahl ceiling

*f* is the symbolic stage over the same run's F4 total (stage clocks on), median over runs [min, max]; *f*<sub>wall</sub> divides the median clocked symbolic stage by the median unclocked process wall. *s*<sub>10%</sub> is the stage speedup for −10% process wall, *f*(1 − 1/*s*) = 0.10; "—" means even an infinitely fast stage saves less than 10%. The ceiling is *f* itself (*s* → ∞).

## Where the serial closure goes (component replay, shipping `Distinct` seeding)

## Level-parallel prototype (#827), replayed on every live batch (`Every` seeding on both sides)
